name: How do I choose the right contractor to fix a bathroom door frame?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor to fix a bathroom door frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a contractor with proven finish carpentry and moisture-restoration experience who inspects behind the trim before quoting. Ask whether they replace damaged subflooring and framing studs if water has spread, or if they only patch surface wood. A qualified contractor should also specify using moisture-resistant materials, such as rot-proof jamb bases, galvanized fasteners, and mildew-resistant caulking. Ensure they test door swing, latch alignment, and floor clearance before completing the job, rather than just forcing the old slab into place.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an experienced carpentry and remodeling contractor who checks for underlying moisture damage, uses rot-resistant materials, and guarantees proper latch alignment.
